# Kairven

Kairven is a business consulting firm in Kanpur, India, building websites, search visibility and enquiry-response systems for clinics, dental practices and home-service businesses. A typical scoped setup takes about seven days after required access and materials are ready.

## What Kairven builds

- Websites and conversion-focused landing pages
- SEO foundations and clear, crawlable service information
- AEO, AIO and GEO foundations that help answer systems understand a business and its services; rankings and citations are not guaranteed
- CRM and lead management
- WhatsApp response paths and agreed team handoffs
- Automations, booking systems and funnels
- Ongoing website and system maintenance

## Custom packages

- Kairven Web: website foundation; typical scoped setup takes about seven days after required access and materials are ready
- Kairven Growth: website, visibility and lead-capture foundations
- Kairven Systems: CRM, WhatsApp, lead management, automations and bookings
- Kairven Multi Locations: location-specific visibility, pages and lead routing

All packages are customised and priced against a written scope. Payment is 50% before work begins and 50% on approval before deployment. Connected systems, integrations and multi-location projects follow the timeline agreed in writing.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kairven.netlify.app/): Done-for-you websites, search and enquiry-response systems for clinics, dental practices and home-service businesses.
- [About Kairven](https://kairven.netlify.appabout/): Founder, business background, location and working approach.
- [Website design](https://kairven.netlify.app/services/website-design/): Website strategy, design and development.
- [Local search](https://kairven.netlify.app/services/local-search/): Search visibility and location information foundations.
- [CRM setup](https://kairven.netlify.app/services/crm/): CRM, lead ownership and follow-up workflows.
- [Lead response](kairven.netlify.app/services/lead-response/): Response, WhatsApp and booking follow-up systems.
- [FAQs](https://kairven.netlify.app/faq/): Answers about services, the typical seven-day setup, custom pricing, follow-up and getting started.
- [Insights](https://kairven.netlify.appirven.github.io/blog/): A practical guide to responding to enquiries and planning follow-up.
- [Privacy policy](https://kairven.netlify.app/privacy-policy/): Current information about contact form handling and website data.
- [Terms](https://kairven.netlify.app/terms/): Conditions for using the site and agreeing a project scope.
